body: Kodak Black got way too real on this Hotboii feature Kodak Black was really feeling every word when he hopped on Hotboii’s “Live Life D*e Faster. ” You can tell he wasn’t just going through the motions here. The way Kodak delivers his verse makes it feel personal, like he’s speaking from experience rather than just rapping along to a beat. He really put himself into this one. “Live Life D*e Faster” is one of those tracks where you can hear the emotion behind the lyrics.

source_caption_text:
Kodak Black got way too real on this Hotboii feature 😭

Kodak Black was really feeling every word when he hopped on Hotboii’s “Live Life D*e Faster.” You can tell he wasn’t just going through the motions here. 

The way Kodak delivers his verse makes it feel personal, like he’s speaking from experience rather than just rapping along to a beat. He really put himself into this one.

“Live Life D*e Faster” is one of those tracks where you can hear the emotion behind the lyrics. Kodak was locked in on this verse.
